chapter: Nola band, day job and nightclub work
title: Nene Cuoco, 'Pills' and Henry Rush
summary: He knew of Nene Cuoco, played a good while with crippled Pills, and counts drummer Henry Rush a friend.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You know, uh, did you ever know a guy from down the river named Nene Cuoco?
No, Dene Cuoco. Ernest. Ernest. I know the name good. He was his trumpet player. You know, calling the name, it makes me like a older man, but I don't know him. He was Pills' brother.

Pills, crippled Pills. We used to call, I never, I didn't know Pills' right name. What's up? Called him Pills, crippled Pills. You played with you? Yeah, I played with him for a long, you know, for the good while together.
What did they call him, Crowback or something? Crowback? Did you ever hear that nickname, Henry Rush?
Covett, Henry Rush, yeah. I might call him a personal friend, Henry Rush, he was a drummer.
Yeah, well he was telling us about it.
And then he played cornet one time too.
